verdict.rationale: Runpod's Instant Clusters docs explicitly describe fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking for distributed training, positioned as self-service ('without managing infrastructure, networking, or cluster configuration') alongside the broader self-service account/API/CLI provisioning flow, suggesting no sales cycle is required. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming instant self-serve checkout for clusters (vs. requiring a quote/sales contact) nor independent/community corroboration of successfully provisioning a multi-node cluster or of interconnect performance; community evidence only touches on single-GPU availability issues, not clusters. Missing for 10: explicit self-service pricing/checkout flow for clusters, independent hands-on confirmation of provisioning speed and interconnect quality.
